d: User can turn the unit on or off via the App anytime, anywhere with a network connection.
The App shows inlet (pre-filter) and outlet (post-filter) TDS readings side by side so users can clearly see filtration effectiveness.
For units with hot/cold taps, quickly select Cold / Hot / Room-temperature water mode directly in the App.
Shows total liters of purified water used per day/week/month.
Displays the actual ratio between purified water obtained and wastewater discharged (e.g. 2:1), helping users track system efficiency.
A moisture sensor detects leaks around the unit or connecting pipes, alerting immediately in the App.
For units with a storage tank, alerts and automatically shuts off the pump when water level reaches full, preventing overflow.
Notifies when the inlet water pressure is too low or too high compared to the unit's recommended threshold.
If post-filter TDS exceeds the safe allowed level (suspected damaged filter or torn RO membrane), alerts immediately and recommends inspection.
Locks the hot-water tap's direct physical controls, only unlockable via the password-protected App — especially important for units with a hot water tap.
Shows the remaining percentage of each filter separately (sediment filter, RO membrane, functional filter, etc.) instead of just one combined indicator.
Notifies before a filter is close to expiring (around 10–15% remaining) so users can proactively prepare a replacement.
When a filter is about to expire, the App suggests and lets users order genuine replacement filters directly, delivered to their home.
Step-by-step video guide right in the App helps users replace filters themselves at home without calling a technician.
Stores the history of past filter changes with dates, useful for warranty reference or calculating the next replacement cycle.
The unit automatically flushes the RO membrane on a set schedule to extend membrane lifespan, no manual action needed.
Periodic reminder to clean the water tap and storage tank (if any) to keep the water source sanitary.
Send a technical support request (unit check, filter change, deep cleaning) directly from the App, choosing a convenient date and time.
Pair the unit with the home WiFi network via the App for remote control and monitoring.
Assign a memorable name and room to each unit, shown clearly in the device list.
Turn on/off and select water output mode by voice command via Google Assistant / Amazon Alexa.
Invite household members to monitor/control the unit together via a secondary account; access can be revoked anytime.
For households with multiple purifiers (kitchen, living room...), manage all of them centrally on one screen.
Plots inlet/outlet TDS changes by day, week, and month to track the regional water source quality.
For units with a booster pump/UV lamp, estimates power consumption by day/week/month.
Export a PDF/Excel report of TDS readings and filter replacement history, useful for record-keeping or reference.
Stores every past error with timestamp for quick reference when contacting warranty support.
Send the activity log and error codes directly to the Livotec support team for remote diagnosis.
Update the unit's control software over WiFi, no need to bring it to a service center.
Twist-lock filter cartridge design with in-App step-by-step guidance lets users replace filters themselves without a technician. (Ref: Xiaomi Mi Smart Water Purifier)
For units with a built-in UV lamp, the App shows its operating status and lamp lifespan, ensuring water in the tank stays continuously disinfected. (Ref: Xiaomi Mi Smart Water Purifier RO+UV)
Automatically detects the tank water level and regulates the pump, no manual monitoring needed. (Ref: Xiaomi Mi Home)

Manage, monitor TDS, and track filter life of multiple purifiers at once on a single interface — suited for offices or restaurants with several filtration points. (Ref: Xiaomi Mi Home multi-device monitoring)
Sends a push notification the moment a filter reaches replacement threshold, even when the App is closed. (Ref: FIN Smart App)
The unit automatically runs a periodic cleaning cycle without user intervention, keeping it consistently sanitary. (Ref: FIN Smart App)

g: Breakthrough Features — Not Yet Offered by Any Brand
d: The App analyzes historical inlet TDS data over time to identify seasonal water-quality patterns (rainy/dry season), proactively warning ahead of periods when inlet water tends to worsen.

d: Instead of a fixed wastewater ratio, the unit automatically optimizes the discharge ratio based on actual inlet TDS — lower TDS reduces wastewater to save water, higher TDS increases flushing to protect the RO membrane.

d: When connected to a Livotec smart rice cooker/kettle, automatically confirms the filtered water source meets standard before those appliances begin operating, ensuring the entire cooking chain uses clean water.
